query: 44-year-old male. In male patients 39–49 with ACS and LOS 1–7 days, report p25, p50, p75 of ultrasounds (incl. echo) per admission, stratified 1–4 vs 5–7 stays and primary vs secondary ACS.
final_sql: SELECT p.subject_id, p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, s.stay_id, s.los, d.diagnosis_id, d.diagnosis_code, d.diagnosis_name, u.procedure_id, u.procedure_code, u.procedure_name, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY p.subject_id, s.stay_id ORDER BY u.procedure_id) AS procedure_rank, percentile_cont(0.25) OVER (PARTITION BY p.subject_id, s.stay_id ORDER BY u.procedure_id) AS p25, percentile_cont(0.75) OVER (PARTITION BY p.subject_id, s.stay_id ORDER BY u.procedure_id) AS p75 FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN icustays s ON a.subject_id = s.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = s.stay_id JOIN procedures_icd u ON u.subject_id = p.subject_id AND u.hadm_id = a.hadm_id AND u.chartdate BETWEEN s.intime AND s.outtime JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON d.subject_id = p.subject_id AND d.hadm_id = a.hadm_id AND d.diagnosis_date BETWEEN s.intime AND s.outtime WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 39 AND 49 AND s.los BETWEEN 1 AND 7 AND u.procedure_code IN ('US', 'ECHO') AND d.diagnosis_code IN ('ACS', 'ACS2') ORDER BY p.subject_id, s.stay_id, procedure_rank NULLS LAST;
